description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Group A water-system polygons describe approved exclusive service areas under the Coordinated Water System Plan. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including WTR_SYS_NA, WTR_MGT_AG, WTR_SYS_ID, CONTACTINF, WATERPURID, BUNDLED_PLAN. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. The source defines Group A systems as serving at least 15 connections regularly; service rights do not prove all properties are connected or establish hydraulic capacity. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
